analysis_result.analysis: The model made two critical errors. First, it assumed that the longest spatial trajectory (white to blue) must correspond to the longest time duration, despite the ground truth explicitly providing timing data showing that segment took 2.00 seconds — which is indeed the longest — but the question asks for the *shape* that took the longest time to reach *from the previous shape*. The correct interpretation is that the *previous* shape (white) is the one from which the longest-duration movement originated. The model incorrectly labeled the destination (blue) as the answer. This reflects a failure in temporal reasoning (misjudging duration based on distance) and textual logic (misattributing the temporal property to the wrong object in the sequence).
